sunoData.title: Lantern Plaza
sunoData.tags: Instrumental game music, bright mid-tempo fantasy-pop with bouncy marimba ostinatos, plucky synth bells, light hand percussion, and a buoyant four-on-the-floor pulse; verse-like loop starts with kalimba and pizzicato bass, main theme blooms with warm brass stabs and sparkling countermelodies, mid-break strips to toy-box arps and airy pads before the final lift returns fuller. Whistly transition chimes, reverse swell hits, and glittering ear-candy fills between phrases. Clean, colorful, game-ready mix with crisp highs and a glossy, uplifting center., bright, joyful, ambient, playful
